Case: Beth is a 62-year-old who is post-op day 3 status-post bi-frontal craniotomy for resection of an olfactory groove meningioma. Beth is meeting all milestones for discharge, however she continues to have significant head pain at the site of her craniotomy. During your pre-discharge physical examination, you note that there is expected frontal scalp swelling and tenderness to palpation of her incision site. You review the medication administration record and see that she has required 1 dose of hydrocodone every 6 hours for pain control.
Question: Would you offer a hydrocodone prescription to Beth? Yes or No? If yes, how much supply would you give – Low (1 week), or High (4 weeks) supply? Explain.
